exercise.prompt:
Make a quiz leaderboard. Read the scores as whole numbers on one line, separated by spaces.
1. Print the top three scores, highest first, as `1. 90`, `2. 72` and so on (fewer if there are fewer scores). Hint: `nums.sort((a, b) => b - a)` sorts from highest to lowest.
2. Print `Average:` and the average with one decimal place, using `.toFixed(1)`.
3. Print `Passed:` and how many scores are 40 or more.
exercise.promptHi:
Ek quiz leaderboard banao. Scores ek line mein whole numbers ki tarah padho, spaces se alag.
1. Top teen scores print karo, sabse zyada pehle, `1. 90`, `2. 72` aise (scores kam hon toh kam). Hint: `nums.sort((a, b) => b - a)` sabse zyada se sabse kam tak sort karta hai.
2. `Average:` aur average ek decimal place ke saath print karo, `.toFixed(1)` se.
3. `Passed:` aur kitne scores 40 ya usse zyada hain, print karo.
